standard_prerequisites.name: Ringed site and complexes of O-modules
standard_prerequisites.statement: A ringed site (C, O) and the derived category D(O) of complexes of O-modules, with its compact objects.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the setting and the hypothesis that K^bullet represents a compact object (source lines 6340-6344).

standard_prerequisites.name: Derived tensor product with a fixed complex
standard_prerequisites.statement: The left derived functor - tensor^L_E K^bullet : D(E,d) to D(O) of the earlier lemma, and its right adjoint R Hom(K^bullet, -) (the author's lemmas lemma-tensor-with-complex-derived and lemma-tensor-with-complex-hom-adjoint, retained as context).
standard_prerequisites.use: The functor whose full faithfulness is asserted, and the adjunction used to reduce the claim (source lines 6350-6360).

standard_prerequisites.name: Endomorphism dg algebra computing Ext
standard_prerequisites.statement: E = Hom over the dg category of complexes from K^bullet to itself, assumed to compute the Ext groups of K^bullet in D(O).
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the algebra the source category D(E,d) is taken over, and it is the second hypothesis of the statement (source lines 6345-6346, 6372-6373).

standard_prerequisites.name: Property (P) modules and their filtration sequences
standard_prerequisites.statement: Every dg E-module has a quasi-isomorphic representative with property (P), carrying an admissible filtration with graded pieces direct sums of shifts of E, and a split admissible short exact sequence displaying the filtration (the author's lemma lemma-property-P-sequence, retained as context).
standard_prerequisites.use: The replacements and reductions of the proof run along this filtration (source lines 6366-6371).

core_obligations: Reduce to one map: using the adjunction between - tensor^L_E K^bullet and R Hom(K^bullet, -), show that full faithfulness is equivalent to the map from H^0(M) to the derived Hom of K^bullet with M tensor^L_E K^bullet being an isomorphism for every dg E-module M (source lines 6358-6366).
Replace M: pass to a dg E-module P with property (P) (source lines 6366-6367).
Use compactness twice: cut the property-(P) filtration to a finite one with graded pieces direct sums of E[k], and then reduce to the case P = E[k] (source lines 6367-6372).
Conclude from the hypothesis: observe that for P = E[k] the required isomorphism is exactly the assumption that E computes the Ext groups of K^bullet (source lines 6372-6373).

proof_roadmap.step: Use the adjunction to reduce full faithfulness to the isomorphism on H^0 for every dg E-module.
Replace the module by a property-(P) representative.
Use compactness of K^bullet to reduce along a finite filtration to direct sums of E[k], and then to P = E[k].
Identify the remaining case with the hypothesis on K^bullet and conclude.

difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-fully-faithful-in-compact-case at source lines 6338-6356: for a ringed site and a complex of O-modules K^bullet which represents a compact object of D(O) and whose endomorphism dg algebra computes its Ext groups, the derived tensor functor - tensor^L_E K^bullet out of dg E-modules is fully faithful. The proof at source lines 6358-6374 uses the adjunction proved two lemmas earlier to reduce full faithfulness to the single map from H^0(M) into the corresponding derived Hom being an isomorphism, then replaces M by a property-(P) representative, and uses compactness twice: once to cut the property-(P) filtration down to a finite one with graded pieces direct sums of E[k], and once more to reduce to P = E[k], where the statement is exactly the hypothesis on K^bullet. It is short, but the card's substance is the correct use of the adjunction criterion for full faithfulness and of compactness inside the two reductions, which the statement does not spell out.
